thread:
Maria Chen: Following the postmortem, I'm opening a check-in thread to track owners and timelines for the cross-region LB->DNS retry wave that started last month. Short status and who owns what pls.
James Patel: Quick summary — we saw TLS handshakes fail intermittently when traffic routed to eu-west fallback nodes, causing 502s + elevated retries. Root cause draft: stale SNI mapping in weighted routing + intermittent BGP flap.
Anika Roy: Can we not conflate BGP + app-level TLS. Evidence points to routing shuffles exposing nodes with expired cert chains in the pool. Logs attached in the postmortem.
Liam O'Connor: I can own the routing side (validate weighted routing table + BGP flaps). Action A1: audit all region routing maps and SNI mappings. ETA EOW (2025-11-12). I'll run post-audit and post a short runbook. @Maria Chen fyi. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: Assigning A2 to @Priya Singh for cert inventory & expiry automation. She'll add alerts for cert-chain mismatches and a daily cert-certificate-health job. ETA: 2025-11-15. :calendar:
Priya Singh: Confirmed. I'll add a Prom alert: "cert_chain_mismatch_rate > 0.01 for 5m" and a PagerDuty escalation step. Also adding an automated cert refresh checklist to the ops runbook.
James Patel: Action A3 (me): create a routing fallback policy to prefer verified TLS-capable backends during spikes. Prototype patch in canary tonight. If it's safe, we'll push canary to us-east first.
SRE-Bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment queued for james/routing-fallback-proto on cluster:frontdoor-us-east. Check: ci/tests-routing-stability: 12/12 passed.
Anika Roy: Also proposing A4: enable short-lived prefix-based KV cache for SNI->backend mapping to reduce stale mapping exposure during control-plane churn. Owner: @Liam O'Connor. ETA: 2025-11-18.
Liam O'Connor: Ack. I'll prototype with a 60s TTL and measure missrate + latency impact. Will post bench results in this thread.
Maria Chen: Recurring incident pattern note from postmortem: similar retry storms observed in Mar and Aug 2025 after control-plane updates. We need a monthly audit and a post-change smoke test to break the pattern. Action A5: monthly audit + pre/post change smoke — owner: Product Infra team (James + Anika).
James Patel: I'll add a pre-change smoke step to the CI flow that runs a TLS handshake healthcheck against a sample of backends in each region. Will include -servername checks and full chain verification.
Priya Singh: For immediate mitigation, I recommend lowering aggressiveness of client retries at the LB edge for 60s after routing changes. Might reduce user-visible 502s while we stabilize. Thoughts?
Anika Roy: That seems reasonable, but we should simulate load to ensure we don't create longer tail latencies. Add as a temporary policy toggle with metric guardrails.
Maria Chen: OK action tracker summary (brief): A1 Audit routing tables + SNI mappings — Liam — ETA 11/12; A2 Cert inventory & alerting — Priya — ETA 11/15; A3 Routing fallback policy canary — James — tonight; A4 SNI mapping TTL cache prototype — Liam — ETA 11/18; A5 Monthly audit + CI smoke tests — James/Anika — ongoing.
James Patel: I'll create tickets in Jira and link them here by EOD. Ticket prefixes: INFRA-rr (routing), SEC-cert, SRE-cache.
SRE-Bot: jira-bot: created INFRA-rr-412, SEC-cert-271, SRE-cache-133 — links: https://jira.redwood.corp/browse/INFRA-rr-412, https://jira.redwood.corp/browse/SEC-cert-271, https://jira.redwood.corp/browse/SRE-cache-133
Maria Chen: Let's have a short sync tomorrow at 09:30 PT to align on canary and alerts. @Liam @James @Priya please confirm availability.
Liam O'Connor: I can do 09:30 PT.
Priya Singh: Available.
James Patel: On calendar.
Maria Chen: Nice. Also adding a follow-up check-in in 2 weeks to verify regression numbers (retry rate, TLS failure rate). I'll update the postmortem with these owners and actions. :memo:
Anika Roy: One last note — include an explicit rollback plan for any routing fallback. Document circuit-breaker thresholds when we flip the fallback policy.
Maria Chen: Good call. Adding as item A6: rollback/circuit-breaker doc — owner: Anika — ETA: 11/14.
James Patel: Thanks all. Closing this thread for asynchronous updates — please post any test artifacts/logs here. :eyes:
